verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a dedicated Monitors page giving a centralized, real-time view of active compliance monitors, system health, and violations, plus automatic collection of compliance-relevant data with alerts on violations — directly matching continuous control monitoring beyond annual audits. Missing for 10: explicit detail on monitoring cadence/latency (e.g., 'hours' turnaround), and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
